title: Will Google’s Genie 3 Shift Take-Two (TTWO) From AI Follower To Gaming Innovation Leader?
text: In recent days, concerns about AI-driven disruption in game development intensified after Google unveiled its Genie 3/Project Genie world-model technology, drawing direct comparisons to the tools used by established publishers like Take-Two Interactive Software ahead of its upcoming earnings release. This has turned generative AI from a distant concept into a practical competitive question for Take-Two, sharpening investor focus on how the company might incorporate or respond to such tools...
